.octos/KNOWLEDGE-DIGEST.md: - **2026-10-01 U11 native 候选:ANativeWindow_lock/unlockAndPost 设计+补丁草稿(benchmark/2026-10-01-anativewindow-lock/)**:我们 libandroid.so 有 acquire/release/fromSurface/getWidth/getFormat/query/setBuffersGeometry/DataSpace/Transform/tryAllocateBuffers,**缺 lock/unlockAndPost**(头条 7 个 .so 引用、fd-plus Surface 软件 lock 墙同源,=NDK 软件画布路径)。照抄 AOSP14 Surface::lock/unlockAndPost:lock=dequeue→等 fence→gralloc CPU 锁得 vaddr→填 ANativeWindow_Buffer{width,height,stride(像素),format(AOSP),bits}→记 locked buf;unlockAndPost=gralloc 解锁→queueBuffer。映射到 OH:dequeue=OH_NativeWindow_NativeWindowRequestBuffer;CPU 地址=OH_NativeWindow_GetBufferHandleFromNative(ohBuf)->virAddr(OH 对 CPU-usage buf 内部已 mmap,[WESTLAKE-CPUFILL]/oh_canvas_renderer lockCanvas 同法;virAddr 空则 mmap(fd,size) 自己管);post=OH_NativeWindow_NativeWindowFlushBuffer(oh,buf,-1,Region)。**关键 stride/format 映射**:OH BufferHandle.stride 是**字节**行距、format 是 GRAPHIC_PIXEL_FMT_*;ANativeWindow_Buffer.stride 是**像素**、format 是 ANDROID_PIXEL_FORMAT_*→ format=oh_pixel_format_to_android(h->format)(surface/jni/pixel_format_mapper.h,OH 12=AOSP 1 RGBA_8888,码不同),stride_px=h->stride/android_bytes_per_pixel(fmt)(字节→像素,本桥最常见的歪图 bug 点)。实现在 framework/window/jni/oh_anativewindow_shim.cpp(AdapterAnw+OH 声明+dequeue/flush helper 都在;#include pixel_format_mapper.h),extern C 导出;与 oh_anw_wrap 关系:lock/unlockAndPost 是同一 AdapterAnw 上 10-hook 表(hwui GPU 路径)的**同侪**,走同一 OH 窗口的 dequeue/flush,只多 CPU 映射与一槽 locked-buffer 记在 AdapterAnw 上,不改 hook 表/oh_anw_wrap。需补:真 BufferHandle 结构+GetBufferHandleFromNative 声明、AdapterAnw 加 lockedOh/lockedMap/lockedSize/dirty、android_bytes_per_pixel、SET_USAGE CPU 保证 virAddr、fence poll+close、一次只一个 locked(再 lock 返 -EINVAL)。待审:OH BufferHandle 字段序需按目标镜像 buffer_handle.h 核(virAddr 偏移错则 bits 乱);部分脏区 copy-forward 暂略(全刷 OK)。证据 design.md + anativewindow-lock-draft.cpp。
